Article title: Notice
Description: Youper is a wellbeing AI chatbot. Not a therapist or medical device. For adults 18+ only. Not a substitute for professional mental health care.

Article text:
Notice
Youper is shutting down September 30, 2026 — export your data
Youper, Inc. is closing and winding down its business. All services will end on September 30, 2026. Please download your data before that date. Beginning October 1, 2026, all remaining user data will be securely and permanently deleted.
Your data belongs to you. Export is available through September 30, 2026.
1. Open the Youper app and go to Settings.
2. Select "Request my data".
‍
If you no longer have access to the app, use this link: start.youper.ai/export-data
